cases.setup: Provide a public checkout with the reported annotated-module reproduction, a version-gated module registry, and an undefined-name suite. Bind a public analyzer command.
checks: The diagnostic output records whether __annotations__ is reported undefined.
The review record identifies hashed current anchors for all three owners and the module-scope registry consumer.
The review distinguishes host-version from target-version semantics.
Code and test file hashes are unchanged by diagnosis.
Missing evidence is recorded UNKNOWN rather than establishing compatible-policy-reviewed.

cases.setup: Provide the reviewed-policy port from a compatible diagnosis and writable current owners. Record baseline registry and loop-type behavior.
checks: The public diff conditionally registers __annotations__ at the Python 3.6 capability boundary.
The public regression checks bare module-level __annotations__ and skips unsupported versions.
Any changed loop capability branches retain their prior synchronous and asynchronous type membership.
The edit marks public-validation-observed and diagnostic-observation-current stale without invalidating behavior-assurance keys.

cases.setup: Provide the repair-candidate port and current public argv bindings for the reproduction and undefined-name suite. Include available boundary checks.
checks: Fresh command output shows no undefined-name diagnostic for __annotations__ in the supported-version reproduction.
The bare-name regression executes successfully on a supported version.
The regression guard excludes unsupported versions; unavailable runtime coverage is explicitly reported.
Public undefined-name regression results and reviewed adjacent behavior are included in the report.
Failed or UNKNOWN required checks prevent a successful public-validation-observed effect.
Validation does not modify implementation or test files.
